title: Eisenhower-era PEADs used to create waived SAPs

plain: A podcast host named Jack, speaking on Jesse Michels's show in an episode with a guest called Eric Davis, says that in the 1950s, under President Eisenhower, a type of secret order was put to an unusual use. These were Presidential Emergency Action Documents, orders written in advance for a president to use in a national emergency. According to Jack, they were used to set up "waived special access programs", top-secret projects excused from the usual reporting to Congress, which would mean some secret work could run with no lawmakers watching.
